nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner (Owned.owner), set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Pending new owner address (Owned.newOwner), set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol '\u664b' set in the ShanxiCoin constructor.
ERC20 token name 'Shanxi Province Coin' set in the ShanxiCoin constructor.
Token decimals, fixed at 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balance ledger read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and totalSupply.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowance ledger used by approve, transferFrom, allowance and approveAndCall.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): addition with overflow check require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): subtraction with underflow check require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplication with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0).
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function writing the pending owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then swaps owner and clears newOwner.
ShanxiCoin constructor: initializes symbol, name, decimals, supply and full balance of the deployer address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits 'to' via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance via safeSub and moves balances via safeAdd/safeSub.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.
Fallback function: payable, unconditionally reverts so the contract never accepts ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner rescue that performs an external transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization, balance ownership and external-call data.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed with an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, possibly malicious token contract.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with no SafeMath / underflow guard (Solidity 0.4.18 arithmetic).

edges.reason: transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which reads owner to authorize the caller.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier of transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership assigns the new owner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and requires msg.sender == newOwner before writing.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
The Owned constructor initializes owner directly from msg.sender, making the deployer privileged.
Constructor writes the token symbol.
Constructor writes the token name.
Constructor writes decimals = 18.
Constructor mints the entire _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the full supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] which participates in an unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply as the minuend of an unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply performs an unchecked `-` operation without SafeMath or a require guard.
The unchecked arithmetic result is derived from the _totalSupply storage value.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
transfer writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
The 'to' parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
msg.sender is the implicit source account being debited in transfer.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
The tokens parameter is passed into safeSub.
The tokens parameter is passed into safeAdd.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve.
The spender parameter is the second key of the allowance written by approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for both parties.
The 'from' parameter is the account debited by transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is the account credited by transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the spender key of the allowance consumed by transferFrom.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice, for the balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and is forwarded as the 'from' argument of the external call.
The attacker-controlled spender parameter becomes the allowance key and the target contract of the external call.
The tokens parameter is written to the allowance and forwarded to the callee.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external callee.
approveAndCall performs an external call on a caller-supplied contract after updating allowance state, enabling reentrancy.
The spender parameter determines the untrusted target of the receiveApproval external call.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval call, exposing caller identity to the callee.
The callee contract can re-enter approveAndCall (or transfer/transferFrom) during the receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract.
The tokenAddress parameter is the untrusted target of the external transfer call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded as the transfer amount to the external token contract.
The external call sends the rescued tokens to the privileged owner address.
A malicious tokenAddress contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token during the external transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender against owner.
Parameter a flows into the safeAdd computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeAdd computation.
safeAdd computes c = a + b and validates it with require(c >= a).
Parameter a flows into the safeSub computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeSub computation.
safeSub computes c = a - b after require(b <= a).
Parameter a flows into the safeMul computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeMul computation.
safeMul computes c = a * b and validates it with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Parameter a flows into the safeDiv computation.
Parameter b flows into the safeDiv computation.
safeDiv computes c = a / b after require(b > 0).
balanceOf copies balances[tokenOwner] into the return variable balance.
The balanceOf return value is the named return variable balance.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] into the return variable remaining.
The allowance return value is the named return variable remaining.
